groups.name: Foundation
groups.description: The base every other module stands on. Inherited from the NEXIS client platform and re-themed for AGS.

modules.name: Sign-in and mandatory 2FA
modules.summary: Email and password sign-in; every account must set up an authenticator app, enforced in the database as well as the app.

modules.name: Roles and invites
modules.summary: Admin, staff and sub-contractor roles; people sign up from an invite list.

modules.name: Business units
modules.summary: Head Office plus optional separate units, each with its own details and branding.

modules.name: AGS look and feel
modules.summary: Cormorant Garamond and Jost, AGS colours, dark and light mode, logo from settings, shared page header.

modules.name: Interactive dashboard framework
modules.summary: Choose, arrange and resize tiles per person. Tiles arrive with each module.

modules.name: Team directory and profiles
modules.summary: Who's who across the system, with contact details shown only where allowed.

modules.name: Roadmap
modules.summary: This page: what is built, in progress and planned.

groups.name: People
groups.description: Employees and sub-contractors in one area, with a strict split between HR and compliance.

modules.name: People data design
modules.summary: Records, permissions and screens for employees, sub-contractors and suppliers. For review before any code.

modules.name: People & HR settings: templates and job roles
modules.summary: Versioned contract templates and a job roles library in Settings. MD service agreement drafted, awaiting solicitor review.

modules.name: People onboarding (employees and sub-contractors)
modules.summary: One process for both: add, invite link, six-step self-service form, typed-name signature, office Accept or Reject, then login via sign-up. Built, with a stored signed PDF, a Compliance tab, a dashboard expiry tile and renewal capture. Reminder emails and the employee contract wording still to come.

modules.name: Suppliers (including agencies)
modules.summary: Anyone AGS buys from: materials, services, agencies and sub-contractor businesses. One record per business.

modules.name: Sub-contractors and compliance
modules.summary: Engagement type, CIS status, insurance, status checks (CEST), contract and workers with logins.

modules.name: Employees (HR)
modules.summary: Staff records, time away, qualifications and training. Employees only; never applied to sub-contractors.

modules.name: Compliance tracking and alerts
modules.summary: Site cards, insurance and certificates with expiry dates, and a dashboard tile for what is expiring.

groups.name: Clients, sites and jobs
groups.description: The core of the work: who it is for, where it is and what stage it is at.

modules.name: Clients
modules.summary: Client records with bulk import. Template version; to be reworked for AGS (private clients, builders, commercial).

modules.name: Sites and map positions
modules.summary: Addresses with postcode lookup and map positions.

modules.name: Jobs
modules.summary: Replaces the template's Projects: stages, dates, scope, value, documents. Includes allocations of people to jobs.

modules.name: Enquiries and quotes
modules.summary: Enquiry intake from the website, quoting, conversion to a job.

modules.name: Job map
modules.summary: Map of jobs by status, sector and team, with a dashboard tile.

groups.name: Operations
groups.description: Running the work day to day.

modules.name: Resource allocations and schedule
modules.summary: Who is on which job and when, whether employee, sub-contractor or agency worker. Drives the schedule and labour cost.

modules.name: Job cards and photos
modules.summary: Sub-contractors log in to see allocated works, with photos and sign-off.

modules.name: Health and safety
modules.summary: RAMS, inductions, incident log.

modules.name: WIP documents
modules.summary: Work-in-progress documents built up as a job moves and sent to the client.

groups.name: Finance
groups.description: Money in, money out and margin. Locked down by role at database level.

modules.name: Invoices and payments
modules.summary: Invoices raised, due, paid, retentions and ageing.

modules.name: Job costing and margin
modules.summary: Labour from allocations plus materials, against quoted value.

modules.name: CIS records
modules.summary: Verification, deductions and payment statements for sub-contractors.

modules.name: Accounting integration
modules.summary: Sync with the accounting software once chosen.

groups.name: Portals and reporting
groups.description: What clients, builders and the director see.

modules.name: Reporting
modules.summary: Standard reports and exports.

modules.name: Client and builder portals
modules.summary: Controlled access for clients and builders to see their jobs and documents.

modules.name: Website link
modules.summary: Shared project records with the AGS website and enquiries flowing in.

groups.name: Hosting and platform
groups.description: Getting it live and keeping it safe.

modules.name: AGS test database
modules.summary: Own Supabase test project. Waiting on the account invoice. Using the NEXIS demo project meanwhile.

modules.name: AGS live database
modules.summary: Separate live project on a paid plan with daily backups, before any real data.

modules.name: Railway deployment
modules.summary: Test and live environments from one repository.

modules.name: Cloudflare and domain
modules.summary: DNS, SSL and protection on a subdomain of agsdecoratingservices.co.uk, once IT give DNS access.

modules.name: Account recovery and backups
modules.summary: A proper process for lost authenticators and restoring data.

modules.name: Data migration from the current system
modules.summary: Needs the handover document from the current system first.
